title: Star Wars Franchise Overview
body:
Star Wars began with the 1977 film written and directed by George Lucas, and grew into one of the most widely released film franchises in public record, spanning trilogies, standalone films, television series, books and games.

This public edition records only verifiable facts — titles, credited creators, release years and formats — in original wording. It contains no copied dialogue, no script excerpts and no novelization text.

The companion Signature edition is separate, labeled unofficial fiction with original characters and settings, and it claims no affiliation with or endorsement by the rights holders.

How to use this record: start with the overview, then read the work-by-work records in publication order. Every date and credit below is a public fact; no copyrighted text is reproduced anywhere in this database.

title: Star Wars Reading and Viewing Order Guide
body:
Recommended public order for the works in this database is publication and release order, beginning with Star Wars (A New Hope) (1977) and ending with The Rise of Skywalker (2019). That order follows how the franchise actually reached the public, and it avoids assuming any later reordering.

The full order is: Star Wars (A New Hope) (1977); The Empire Strikes Back (1980); Return of the Jedi (1983); The Phantom Menace (1999); Attack of the Clones (2002); Revenge of the Sith (2005); Rogue One (2016); The Force Awakens (2015); The Last Jedi (2017); The Rise of Skywalker (2019). Each title in that list has its own record in this database with its credited creators and format.

This guide contains facts only. It does not reproduce story text, and it does not claim that any Signature continuation belongs in the official order.

print("Works in public order: " + str(len(order)))
